Feature: Create an Annual Plan

BRD reference: Section 4.4 (Annual Plan) · UC20

Goal: As an Authorized user, I want to create an annual plan manually or using AI-assisted suggestions, so that I can define the plan.

Summary: The user creates a new annual plan by entering its name, year and total budget, or by using optional AI suggestions. The plan starts as active and not yet approved; its structure (tracks and initiatives) is built later in the plan edit session (F-05.02). Only one annual plan may exist per year within the same organization.

Stories: the ready story with its full details (scenario, business requirements, errors and fields) is the subtask UC20 – Create an Annual Plan.

text:
Feature: Lock or Reopen an Annual Plan

BRD reference: Section 4.4 (Annual Plan) · UC23

Goal: As an authorized user, I want to lock or reopen an annual plan with a documented decision, so that new approvals are controlled.

Summary: Locking a plan prevents new projects from being approved against it while existing projects and payments continue. Before locking, the user decides how outstanding obligations will be handled and attaches the decision evidence. An authorized user can reopen the plan.

Stories: the ready story with its full details (scenario, business requirements, errors and fields) is the subtask UC23 – Lock or Reopen an Annual Plan.
